description: The Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics publishes Volume 1 of the 2020 National Population and Housing Census Basic Tables as a PDF of 384 pages. The census, run in November 2020, counted 300,019 people and 63,365 private households. Its household chapter gives the age of privately owned houses, floor, wall and roof materials (concrete, bush materials, metal, wood or makeshift), drinking and washing water, toilet type, rubbish disposal, cooking energy and lighting. The electricity table shows 29,815 households on a solar home system and 19,237 on the main grid, with 7,365 having no access. Other tables count transport, appliances and means of communication. Every table is split into urban and rural areas, Port Vila, Luganville, the six provinces and their area councils. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF, no registration; the 2020 analytical report and 2009 and 1999 reports are on the same page. Licence: none found. Caveats: counts use an enumeration area correction factor so totals can differ slightly; the report says tables are also in Excel, but no Excel file was linked on the census page; the round 1 visit read only the homepage. Simulation uses: wall and roof materials for cyclone exposure by area council, and grid versus solar home system shares for rural electrification and resilience planning. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts and electricity access record.

schema_summary: Chapter 9 household tables (pages 296 to 357): 9.2 type of living quarters; 9.3 housing tenure; 9.4 land tenure; 9.5 privately owned houses by age of building; 9.6 rooms; 9.7.1 to 9.7.3 floor, wall (concrete, traditional bush materials, metal, wood, makeshift) and roof materials; 9.8 drinking water; 9.9 washing water; 9.10 toilet facility (pit latrine, VIP, flush, shared); 9.11 rubbish disposal; 9.12 cooking energy (open fire, bottled gas, electricity, solar); 9.13 handwashing; 9.14 lighting; 9.15 electricity source (no access, solar home system, main grid, battery lamp, own generator); 9.16 to 9.18 crops, livestock, fishing; 9.19 means of transport; 9.20 appliances; 9.21 means of communication. All by province and area council. Annex 1 questionnaire.
